evidence.title: AI teammates that finish the work | Grok Bot

name: Grok Bot
summary: Always-on AI teammates that sign in to your tools from their own cloud computer, run routines and hand back finished work.
description: A page on x.ai for Grok Bot: a team of always-on AI teammates. Each Bot signs in to your tools, uses them like a person, learns a routine by watching you work once, and runs in parallel on a persistent cloud computer. Included with Cursor Pro/Pro+/Ultra, SuperGrok plans, Cursor Teams and Enterprise; desktop and iOS apps.
contains: Bots sign in to your tools and use them like a person
each user's Bots share one persistent cloud computer (files, browser, logins)
taught routines run on a schedule; Bots hand work to each other in one thread
included with Cursor Pro ($20/mo), SuperGrok ($30/mo) and Cursor Teams ($40/seat/mo); Enterprise via sales
macOS, Windows and iOS apps; weekly usage included, extra usage billed by token cost
